identificationModule.briefTitle: A Randomized Phase II Clinical Trial on the Efficacy of Axitinib as a Monotherapy or in Combination With Lomustine for the Treatment of Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase II Clinical Trial on the Efficacy of Axitinib as a Monotherapy or in Combination With Lomustine for the Treatment of Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This clinical trial will recruit patients diagnosed with glioblastoma at the time of recurrence or progression following prior treatment with surgery, radiation therapy and alkylating chemotherapy. Patients will be screened and if found eligible will be randomized to one of two treatment arms (1:1 randomization). Patients randomized to the Axitinib treatment-arm will be treated with Axitinib until progression (they can be treated after progression in the Axitinib plus lomustine arm), unacceptable treatment related toxicity, or patients refusal to continue study treatment. Patients randomized to the Axitinib plus Lomustine-arm will receive treatment until progression, unacceptable treatment related toxicity, or patients refusal to continue study treatment.

interventions.name: axitinib
interventions.description: The starting dose of axitinib (AG-013736) is 5 mg BID administered orally with food.

primaryOutcomes.measure: anti-tumor effect of axitinib as a single therapeutic agent and in combination with Lomustine
primaryOutcomes.description: To estimate the anti-tumor effect of axitinib as a single therapeutic agent for the treatment of glioblastoma patients at the time of recurrence/progression following prior surgery, radiation and alkylating chemotherapy and in combination with Lomustine
